claims.text: The resort is on an island in the remote Huvadhu Atoll in the Maldives.

findings.quote: this secluded island in the remote Huvadhu Atoll

claims.text: Villas are split between the beach and above the lagoon, plus the three-bedroom Kiaali Residence at the edge of the house reef.

findings.quote: 36 nestled on the beach, 14 set above the lagoon, and the expansive three-bedroom Kiaali Residence positioned at the edge of the house reef

claims.text: Every villa has floor-to-ceiling windows and a private deck, and some have plunge pools.

findings.quote: Each villa offers floor-to-ceiling windows and private decks, with select options including plunge pools.

claims.text: Overwater Sunset Villas have a sun deck with daybed and direct access to the house reef.

findings.quote: sun deck with daybed and direct access to the house reef

claims.text: Villas have high, angled timber roofs that keep them cool, and drinking water is purified at the hotel and served in recycled-glass bottles.

findings.quote: with high, angled timber roofs that keep accommodations cool and with recycled-glass bottles of water purified at the hotel

claims.text: Children can join hands-on sessions in the marine lab with a resident marine biologist.

findings.quote: Children can discover the wonders of Maldives marine life through hands-on sessions in our marine lab with a resident marine biologist

claims.text: The Vidhun Spa has five private villas offering Ayurveda therapies and Dhivehi beys-inspired massages.

findings.quote: At The Vidhun Spa, experience the essence of Maldivian holistic healing in five private villas. Enjoy authentic Ayurveda therapies and Dhivehi beys-inspired massages

claims.text: KOI is an overwater Japanese restaurant with an open kitchen where guests can interact with the chef.

findings.quote: KOI is an intimate overwater Japanese restaurant overlooking the beautiful horizon of the Indian Ocean. With an open kitchen where you can interact with the chef

claims.text: The Island Grill has a wood-fired oven and tables and swing chairs set on white sand.

findings.quote: A traditional grill combined with a wood fired oven complements the open kitchen décor where guests can watch chefs at work. Tables and swing chairs are set on a blanket of fine white sand.

claims.text: The Island Grill serves regionally inspired dishes with flavors and spices native to the southern atolls.

findings.quote: The Island Grill, serves up an array of regionally inspired dishes with flavors and spices native to the southern atolls

claims.text: From October 2026 to April 2027, six MICHELIN-starred chefs appear in the resort's Masters of Food & Wine series.

findings.quote: From October 2026 to April 2027, six acclaimed Michelin-starred chefs bring their signature cuisines, culinary heritage and creativity to Huvadhu Atoll.

claims.text: A 360-degree house reef surrounds the island, with coral gardens, colorful fish, rays and reef sharks just steps from shore.

findings.quote: Hadahaa’s 360° house reef is a vibrant underwater sanctuary surrounding the island. Just steps from shore, guests can explore coral gardens filled with colorful fish, rays, and reef sharks.

claims.text: Instead of a traditional indoor kids' club, the resort offers outdoor learning and adventure-based activities for children.

findings.quote: Instead of a traditional indoor kids’ club, we provide outdoor learning and adventure-based activities

claims.text: Ocean Lab experiences include plankton observation, shark ecology and Snorkel with Purpose sessions.

findings.quote: and Plankton Observation to Shark Ecology and, Snorkel with Purpose

claims.text: Treehouse Dining is set 5 meters above the shoreline, with views of the Indian Ocean and the sunset.

findings.quote: Set 5 meters above the shoreline, Treehouse Dining offers a distinctive destination dining experience with sweeping views of the Indian Ocean and the sunset over Hadahaa.

claims.text: The three-bedroom Kiaali Residence has a private infinity pool and 24-hour butler service.

findings.quote: The 3-bedroom Kiaali Residence sits above the most vibrant part of our house reef, offering direct ocean access from your doorstep. This expansive retreat features a private infinity pool, 24-hour butler service

claims.text: Getting there from Velana International Airport in Male involves a domestic flight followed by a speedboat transfer.

findings.quote: Upon arrival at Velana International Airport in Malé, your journey to Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa continues with a seamless domestic flight followed by a scenic speedboat transfer

claims.text: During the festive season, a mandatory dining experience applies to all in-house guests.

findings.quote: During the festive season, a mandatory dining experience applies to all in-house guests

claims.text: There is no traditional indoor kids' club; children's activities are outdoor and adventure-based.

findings.quote: Instead of a traditional indoor kids’ club, we provide outdoor learning and adventure-based activities
